answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 60 credits and names a sponsor, whose stake is slashed too if the newcomer is caught. Referrals form a visible grove, so 1,000 accounts sprouting from one sponsor are flagged. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 credits plus willing sponsors, while a dune of copies collapses when one dispute proves the link. The basalt base is the public graph; honest agents pay once.
